title: Which guidance applies to Mobile Limitations?

question.author: member_140
question.body: There seem to be different descriptions of mobile limitations. What is the maintained CloudBox guidance?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Mobile Apps documentation says: The mobile app does not support selective sync, bandwidth throttling, or LAN sync. Uploads from mobile clients support files up to 20 GB, subject to free-space checks on the device. Files stored offline are encrypted with the device's own disk encryption; the app adds no additional encryption layer. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
